definitions.explanation: The act of sorting or separating items based on quality, type, or criteria; distinguishing and selecting.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{選別|せんべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{選別|せんべつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: The ability to screen information is necessary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{選別|せんべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They were hired after a rigorous screening process.

notes:
{選別|せんべつ} means to examine items individually and separate them based on quality, type, or other criteria. It implies a deliberate evaluation process, not just grouping.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {選別|せんべつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sort, to screen
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{選別|せんべつ}: sorting/screening of ~
- {選別|せんべつ}⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧: selection criteria
- {選別|せんべつ}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: sorting work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{分類|ぶんるい}→分類：04790_bunrui⟧: classification (grouping into categories, no quality judgment)
- ⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧: selection (choosing one from several options)
- ⟦{仕分|しわ}け→仕分ける：20080_shiwakeru⟧: sorting (practical allocation into groups, e.g., mail sorting)

USAGE:
Common in contexts like waste sorting (⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{選別|せんべつ}), quality control (⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧{選別|せんべつ}), and information screening (⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{選別|せんべつ}). Often implies discarding items that don't meet the standard.
